craft_notes: Sthāyin: exception-joy. Close: allness (no other). Rejected: 'introvert' — killed: inward-facing kept; 'omniscient' — killed: all-knowingness kept literal.

lines: But who inward-facing is, the seat of knowing-all;
his loss can never be, from perceiving no other at all.
l4.sanskrit_cite: na tu yo 'ntarmukho bhāvah sarvajñātvaguṇāspadam | tasya lopaḥ kadācit syād anyasyānupalambhanāt

reads_against.argmap: But who inward-facing, seat of all-knowingness: his loss never ever — from not perceiving other.
c1_essence: Inward-facing, seat of knowingness: never loss, no other perceived.
